name_reason: Current name is a semantic MISNOMER: the value has nothing to do with portrait-cache sizing. Verified by two writers + one reader. Both writers set it from FDFIELD.DAT tile_event_data_table[1] (zero-extended byte -> dword): fd2_load_chapter_battle_data @ 0x1098B (MOVZX EDX,[EAX+1]; MOV [0x53BE7],EDX) and fd2_load_save_and_init_engine @ 0x10287 (same). It is immediately copied into data_fd2_battle_party_member_count @ 0x53BEB (rsrc.c:343-344, fresh-chapter path) and used as the signed loop bound for the per-slot runtime_char fill loop (read @ 0x10AD9 CMP EBP,[0x53BE7]; JGE). The real portrait-cache fill counter is the distinct sibling data_fd2_resource_portrait_cache_count @ 0x53BDF. So this is the chapter's roster/character slot count read from FDFIELD; proposed name follows data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> with battle domain. CONSISTENCY NOTE for Stage 2: this is one of three siblings sharing the legacy portrait_cache_ group prefix (0x53BDF count = real cache counter; 0x53BE3 alloc_offset = field-spawn record count, also a documented misnomer; 0x53BE7 here). Stage 2 may prefer to rename the 0x53BE3/0x53BE7 misnomers as a group for coherence; 0x53BDF's name is actually correct and should be kept.
purpose: Per-chapter character/roster slot count for the upcoming battle, loaded from FDFIELD.DAT tile_event_data_table[1]; it bounds the runtime_char fill loop and seeds data_fd2_battle_party_member_count.
logic_summary: Set once at chapter/save load from the zero-extended byte tile_event_data_table[1] (the FDFIELD per-chapter header), widened to a uint32 slot by both writers. In the fresh-chapter path it is copied straight into data_fd2_battle_party_member_count (0x53BEB); in the save-load path party_member_count instead comes from the SAVE header (pBuf[0x30C4]) so the two can differ there. Its single read use is as the signed loop bound for iterating roster slots while building runtime_char_array from the FDFIELD template/position data. Despite its legacy name it is unrelated to portrait sprite-cache sizing; the actual cache fill counter is data_fd2_resource_portrait_cache_count @ 0x53BDF.
element_semantics: Scalar uint32 holding a small non-negative count: number of character/roster slots declared for the chapter by FDFIELD.DAT tile_event_data_table[1]. Stored full-dword; written as zero-extended byte, consumed signed as a loop bound.
comment_original_issue: The existing src comment block (main.c) was accurate and detailed about source/usage but did not plainly flag that the legacy NAME is a misnomer (unlike its sibling 0x53BE3's comment which does). Augmented with a misnomer-clarification sentence pointing to the real cache counter at 0x53BDF. The Ghidra data plate was blank (PLATE=null on the data address; semantics only documented in the function plate), so a concise data plate was created.
notes: is_const=false: writers exist on the game side (two MOV [0x53BE7] stores + the copy-out), so it is a mutable zero-init BSS scalar (memory at the address reads all zeros in the image, consistent with BSS). Only the name verdict (proposed) and comment were touched; no symbol rename, no declaration/signature/type/logic change, per src-refine rules. name_final left equal to name_current because rename is deferred to Stage 2.
